rows.grounds: fourth vowel in nominative singular masculine form

items.question: How does the fourth vowel ī enter the kṣmrī bīja?
premises: It is placed thus in kṣmrī.
items.inference: The kṣmrī bīja contains ī as its fourth vowel.
uncertainties: Exact ritual application beyond this verse remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: The fourth vowel is ī; thus [it is] kṣmrī.
